text:
Tara: Heads-up  candidate Samir Patel (SP) confirmed for onsite Tue 2026-07-07. Hes flying in from Mumbai arriving 07:10 PT. Schedule: 09:00 check-in, 09:30-11:30 tech panel, 12:00 lunch + office tour, 13:30-14:30 system design, 15:00 debrief. Needs: visa support letter, hotel night for 7/6, airport pickup, halal lunch, parking pass, background form link. Can someone own travel/logistics?

RecruiterBot: Candidate travel request submitted. ETA for approval: 24 hours. Request ID: TR-1969004322.

Tara: @TravelOpsBot can you handle hotel booking and airport pickup? Also confirm whether we cover a visa appointment expedite fee if needed.

TravelOpsBot: Hotel booked: Redwood Inn, confirmation 998877. Check-in 2026-07-06, check-out 2026-07-08. Shuttle pickup scheduled from SFO Arrivals at 07:45. Driver: Raj (raj@redwood.example). Itinerary: https://travel.redwood.example/itins/998877

Samir: Thanks all. Quick note  I need a visa support letter and invitation to present at the gate for CBP if possible. Also I follow a halal diet.

Tara: Will do visa letter. @Security please review template and add signature.

Security: Reviewed. NDA and visitor access note added. We'll attach signed visitor policy. Visa support letter will be emailed to Samir by EOD.

TravelOpsBot: Visa support letter created: https://hr.redwood.example/visa/SP-1969004322.pdf

Tara: @Evelyn can you arrange halal lunch (no pork, avoid alcohol sides) and a vegetarian option? Also set aside a quiet room for prayer 12:00-12:30.

Evelyn: Halal lunch ordered (Mediterranean boxed), veg option added. Prayer room reserved (Quiet Room D) 12:00-12:30.

RecruiterBot: Background check link sent to candidate. Candidate must complete by 2026-07-04 to proceed. Form: https://hr.redwood.example/bgcheck/1969004322

Samir: Completed the background form. Also can you confirm whether there will be a laptop provided? I prefer Mac but can use ours.

Tara: We'll provide a loaner MacBook. @FrontDeskBot please label "SAMIR P" and leave with charger + USB-C adapter.

FrontDeskBot: Loaner MacBook reserved and labeled "SAMIR P". Badge and welcome envelope prepared. Parking pass: Lot B - Hangtag B12. QR check-in: https://frontdesk.redwood.example/vis/1969004322

Samir: Appreciate it. Also do you reimburse airport taxi receipts? I might need to take a taxi if flight delayed.

TravelOpsBot: Policy: rideshare/taxi reimbursable up to $80 with receipts. Submit at https://hr.redwood.example/expenses within 7 days.

Tara: Door code for guest laptop station:
```
doorcode: 3165#
```

Security: Reminder  visitors must bring photo ID for check-in. We'll run a short identity verification at front desk.

Samir: Got it. I'll bring passport. Thanks everyone.

Evelyn: I'll circulate a 24-hr reminder with panel names, Zoom backup for remote interviewers, and office arrival instructions.

Tara: Great. I'll post a final day-before checklist and confirm hotel shuttle times tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
